title: My pixel art editor demo is finally live! its a demo still but i would love some feedback from pixel artists on features i could still add , theres still polish needed but thats fine!
author: Affectionate_Fact854
selftext:
I got tired of drawing my animation effects , so I started making scripts , that worked buy then I wanted a all in 1 tool to make small changes before the export 

So I built a free beta version of free installable software for windows allowing live draw , and many tools that asperite has , and a large asset pre made pool 

  
If your working on 16x16 , 32x32 , 64x64 assets and game 

  
Let me know if this tool helps your workflow in creating 3frame or 5frame animations

comments.author: Athena_Webb
comments.body: This definitely still needs some fine-tuning of the details

replies.author: Affectionate_Fact854
replies.body:
In the ichio page it can be downloaded it has much more details to the software itself 

But it's a pixel editor with live drawing support,frame support 
And all file export needed for asprite , png and gif 

It also runs with playback live on only 2% of my i5 processor that's older then 10years and only 83mb memory 


It's free to use offline for any person ,and it's still beta to improve on already implemented features and new features 

End if the day 
The competition software runs on easily 20% of my cpu and needs much more ram just to do frame playback loops 

So this is just a far less cpu intensive alternative

The goal is 
(
Making a sprite editor for pixel art that can stream line building effects and animation loops while being lightweight for toaster computers)
